verdict.rationale: a-Shell's first-party docs say the `pickFolder` command uses iOS file-sharing to open directories inside other apps' sandboxes. You can then run Python or TeX there and send results to a third app, and picked folders are auto-bookmarked for later return. Missing for 10: any evidence of working with repositories specifically (e.g. git operations on picked folders), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor's own docs and README.
